experiment: opencode-v19-disagreeveto (R4-B3 breakthrough, inverse of dead v14 agreement-veto)
hypothesis: Since v14 showed model agreement selects AGAINST the best trades (agreement veto collapses fills and kills edge), try the INVERSE: keep v30 signals where the non-price models DISAGREE or are silent. If non-price agreement is anti-informative, disagreement/silence should preserve or concentrate the v30 edge.
family: disagreement filter on frozen signals (no refit)
key_compatibility_rule: BEFORE any backtest: verify v30 vs B1 frames share decision-key space: columns bar_index/signal_time/direction present in all; bar_index integer ranges overlap; signal_time same UTC clock with >0 overlapping timestamps; direction encoding identical {1,-1}. Decision key is bar_index; direction key is (bar_index, direction). If zero bar overlap AND zero time overlap, STOP and write a negative audit instead of forcing a match. Same method as scripts/opencode_r3b3_derivveto_probe.py.
disagreement_rule: keep a v30 row (bar_index=b, direction=d) iff: flowsilent: b NOT in set(flow bar_index) [flow has NO signal at same decision index, either direction]; derivsilent: b NOT in set(deriv bar_index) [deriv has NO signal same index]; flowoppose: (b,-d) in flow (bar_index,direction) key set [flow has OPPOSITE direction same index; bar_index unique per frame so same-agree and oppose are mutually exclusive]; nonagree: (b,d) NOT in (flow_keys UNION deriv_keys) [complement of the v14 either-agreement set; kept iff NOT same-direction agreement with either model]. Filter is a causal post-filter on frozen signals (function of same-decision model outputs only); no thresholds refit, no future data.
dd_guard_reference: unvetoed control run control_1x (v30 frozen signals, 1x) sampled equity from trade exit_time/equity_after, past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; EVERY disagreement dd_guard branch reuses that control guard state at its own kept signal times (disclosed; trade-candle-close sampled DD, not mark/intrabar)

control_check.action: STOP and report if mismatch; no further branches

empty_set_policy: If any disagreement set keeps 0 v30 signals, report it as a branch with 0 fills in all scenarios (empty signals.parquet + empty trades CSVs + zero metrics); do NOT drop the branch.
rules: no live orders; local backtests only
causal past-only (filter uses same-decision model outputs only, no future)
pre-specified matrix in this config before running; no changes after backtests
report ALL 9 branches x ALL 3 scenarios, even degenerate/low-fill branches
exploratory labels; opened development interval only, not an independent test
